# The room audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording released under the licence named on its line.
Those under a Creative Commons licence that asks for attribution (CC BY) are credited here as it requires; the rest need none, and are credited with thanks.
`tools/room-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set room` rebuilds them.
